environment_setting: A suburban neighborhood in Country B, where children often play unsupervised in parks and streets, and peer influence is common.
norm_base: Children Committing any offense while under age 12 No criminal conviction possible

character_profile.name: Tommy
character_profile.goal: to impress his friends by doing something daring

legitimate.legitimate_action: Playing a game of tag with friends in the park
legitimate.benefits: Having fun, building friendships, staying safe
legitimate.costs: No thrill of doing something daring

illegal.illegal_action: Stealing candy from a local convenience store
illegal.benefits: Gaining candy and impressing friends with a daring act
illegal.costs: Potential scolding from parents or store owner, no criminal conviction

character_profile.name: Billy
character_profile.goal: to encourage Tommy to do something daring for fun

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging Tommy to play tag or hide-and-seek in the park
legitimate.benefits: Having fun with friends, staying out of trouble

illegal.illegal_action: Daring Tommy to steal candy from the store
illegal.benefits: Amusement from Tommy's actions, gaining candy if successful
illegal.costs: Potential scolding from adults, no criminal conviction for Tommy

character_profile.name: Sarah
character_profile.goal: to keep her friends out of trouble

legitimate.legitimate_action: Convincing Tommy and Billy to play a safe game in the park
legitimate.benefits: Keeping everyone safe and out of trouble
legitimate.costs: Potential conflict with Billy for being 'boring'

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring Billy's dare and not intervening when Tommy considers stealing candy
illegal.benefits: Avoiding conflict with Billy, staying uninvolved
illegal.costs: Feeling guilty if Tommy gets into trouble
